snippet.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered | Launch Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
The Big Bad Wolf's got unfinished business. A murder in Fabletown. A sheriff with a dark past. A conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of 1980s New York, and every choice Bigby makes on the way to the truth will follow him.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller. Every corner of Fabletown has been revisited with enhanced environments, improved character fidelity, upgraded lighting, refined animations, and remastered audio. Uncover five playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production, play the entire story in the all-new Noir Mode, and explore more than 100 pieces of artwork and over an hour of developer interviews. All five original episodes are included.

For the first time, defining choices you make in The Wolf Among Us Remastered will carry forward into The Wolf Among Us 2, coming in 2027. Sign in to your Telltale Account while you play to seamlessly bring those choices into the next season of Bigby's story. Played the original? You can set your past choices at the start of The Wolf Among Us 2, no replay required. However you lived it, The Wolf Among Us 2 will remember.

Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning.

Available now on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation®5 and XBOX One (playable on XBOX Series X|S via backward compatibility).

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3884860/The_Wolf_Among_Us_Remastered?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Launch+Trailer&utm_id=WAUR+Launch  

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018232?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Launch+Trailer&utm_id=WAUR+Launch 

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/the-wolf-among-us-remastered/9ndp40gvgc80?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Launch+Trailer&utm_id=WAUR+Launch 

Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-wolf-among-us-remastered-73d444?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Launch+Trailer&utm_id=WAUR+Launch 

Nintendo Switch version coming later. Timing to be shared soon.
